rules.message: AES ECB mode detected in Java; ECB leaks patterns and should not be used for confidential data.
rules.remediation: Use AES/GCM or AES/CTR+HMAC. Ensure unique IV/nonce management and authentication.

rules.message: AES-CBC detected; encryption should be authenticated.
rules.remediation: Prefer AES-GCM. If CBC is required, enforce Encrypt-then-MAC and strict IV management.

rules.message: Deprecated hash algorithm detected (MD5 or SHA-1).
rules.remediation: Use SHA-256 or SHA-3 family for integrity checks; use appropriate KDFs for key derivation.

rules.message: RSA key size below 2048 bits detected.
rules.remediation: Use RSA with at least 2048 bits (prefer 3072+) or migrate to hybrid/PQC approaches.

rules.message: Non-cryptographic PRNG used for cryptographic purposes.
rules.remediation: Use java.security.SecureRandom or other CSPRNG for key/nonce material.
Use at least 100k+ iterations and periodically re-evaluate per hardware baseline.

rules.message: Weak SSL/TLS version detected (SSLv3, TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1 are deprecated).
rules.remediation: Use TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.3 for secure communication.

rules.message: Weak hash algorithm used in signature algorithm.
rules.remediation: Use SHA256withRSA, SHA256withECDSA, or stronger alternatives.

rules.message: Legacy RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 encryption padding pattern detected.
rules.remediation: Prefer OAEP padding for RSA encryption/decryption operations.

rules.message: Classical public-key cryptography detected; prepare post-quantum migration plan.
rules.remediation: Adopt hybrid transition plans with ML-KEM/ML-DSA where policy allows.

rules.message: Generic cipher instance created; verify mode and algorithm are secure.
rules.remediation: Ensure transformation string specifies secure algorithm and mode (e.g., AES/GCM/NoPadding).
